newsitem.title: CHINA: WEIGHTLIFING-CHINESE SETS 70 KG WORLD RECORD.
newsitem.headline: WEIGHTLIFING-CHINESE SETS 70 KG WORLD RECORD.

text.p: China's Wan Jianhui broke the men's 70 kg-category snatch world record at the Asian weightlifting championships in Yangzhou the Xinhua news agency on Wednesday.
Wan, 24, snatched 163 kg at his third attempt, bettering the existing record of 162.5 kg set by compatriot Zhang Xugang at the Atlanta Olympics in July last year.

China's Xing Fen broke the clean and jerk world mark with a lift of 105.5 kg in the women's 46 kg division on Tuesday, Xinhua said. She broke the previous world record of 105 kg held by her compatriot Guan Hong.
